subjects.Anglais: Anglais: English language test (English texts, grammar, vocabulary, writing). Headers or grading grids can be in French. A test titled 'English Test' is Anglais even when the topic is IT (websites, networks, emails)
subjects.Maths: Mathématiques (CBE Math, mathématiques fondamentales, mathématiques renforcées): equations, calculations, geometry, functions, exercises with numbers
subjects.Allemand: Allemand: German language test (German words or texts, Wortschatztest, Deutsch). Vocabulary tests list French words to translate into German. German headers like Name + Vorname, Klasse, Datum, Grammatik, Hören, Insgesamt mean Allemand, even when the class code is XMPT or TASV
subjects.Français: Français: French language itself: grammar, spelling, conjugation, prefixes and suffixes, literature. Not every test written in French is a French test
subjects.Histoire: Histoire et institutions politiques: historical events (revolutions, world wars, colonisation), analysis of a historical source, letter, map or image. Written in French
subjects.Eco&Droit: Économie et droit (ECDR), maturity classes like XMPT: law (droit des obligations, droit pénal, droit commercial), economics
subjects.ECG: Culture générale (ECG, CG), apprentice classes like DEVA: society, apprenticeship contract, bank and post, media and press, analysis of a poster or advert, oral argumentation, basic economics. Written in French
